svg.text: PixelPine: copper islands of the LED pads
480 LED pads = 141 islands (113 with 2+ pads, 28 single).
Same colour = same line net. Thick links = tiny F.Cu bridges.
Label = net name; "L7.2" = 2nd-biggest island of L7.
1 pad: 28, 2 pads: 38, 3 pads: 21, 4 pads: 19, 5 pads: 17, 6 pads: 6, 7 pads: 3
The 240 LED positions are unchanged; only which
anode/cathode pair sits where was optimised.
